publication_year_note: Published June 2015 in The International Indigenous Policy Journal, Volume 6, Issue 3, Article 7; no separate online-first year is printed.
rationale: The full text presents only qualitative findings from semi-structured interviews with 8 Ontario First Nations water system operators and a descriptive quantitative summary (counts, frequencies, and percentages analyzed in Microsoft Excel) from a structured survey of 79 British Columbia First Nations water system operators, alongside secondary descriptive percentages from the 2011 Neegan Burnside Ltd. assessment. No inferential statistical tests, regression estimates, correlation coefficients, confidence intervals, standard errors, test statistics, or p-values are reported anywhere in the study, and the primary empirical variables measure operator certification, compensation, hours worked, job satisfaction, and perceived operational challenges rather than tested contrasts in household or community water service access.
